name: M'ONDUNIQ HI'FUsion Aquadermie Bio-Cell FF Anti-Age face mask
shortDescription: Anti-ageing bio-cellulose face mask with PhytoCellTec serum: hydrates intensively and helps improve skin firmness and elasticity. 5 pcs, each with 8 ml serum.
description:
An innovative, professional bio-cellulose face mask developed to reduce the visible signs of skin ageing, hydrate the skin intensively and support its regeneration.

Soaked in PhytoCellTec serum, the bio-cellulose mask fits closely to the contours of the face for even contact with the skin. It helps improve skin firmness, elasticity and texture while giving the complexion a more hydrated, fresher, smoother and younger look.

An excellent complement to professional anti-ageing, hydrating and regenerating cosmetic treatments.

faq.question: How do you use the mask?
faq.answer: Open the sachet, unfold the bio-cellulose mask and remove the protective layers. Place it on cleansed facial skin from the forehead downwards, fit it around the eyes and mouth, leave on for 20 minutes, then remove.

faq.question: Which skin types is it recommended for?
faq.answer: Mature skin showing signs of ageing, dehydrated skin, skin that has lost firmness and elasticity, tired and dull skin, and skin that needs regeneration and intensive hydration.

faq.question: Can it be used more than once?
faq.answer: No, the mask is for single use. For external use only; avoid contact with eyes and stop using it if irritation occurs.

faq.question: What size is it available in?
faq.answer: 5 bio-cellulose face masks, each soaked in 8 ml PhytoCellTec serum (item number: 69106).
